Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P9 312561850/03
Charger ID/Serial No.:
y6NsFc
Problem Description: HMI Issue
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0393648 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Regarding the issue of HMI screen problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board.Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
1. 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 : Adaptation Set
2. HMI Generation2
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [10/06/2024], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
